name: Shimrath
overview: Shimrath was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shimei. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed narrative provided. This limited information situates him within the genealogical records of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Shimrath is a proper name meaning "guardian" or "watchman." This meaning reflects a role of vigilance or protection, though the name itself was not given directly by God. It is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:21.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shimrath as the son of Shema, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shimrath's significance lies primarily in his inclusion within the genealogical lists of the tribe of Benjamin, which serve to preserve the heritage and lineage of God's people. His mention underscores the faithfulness of God's covenant community through successive generations. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal deeds, his presence in the record contributes to the overall biblical narrative of God's providential care for His chosen lineage.
